item.name: Kealakekua Bay / Captain Cook Monument Snorkel
item.unicode: Kealakekua Bay / Captain Cook Monument Snorkel
item.description:
Join us for an unforgettable snorkeling experience in the pristine waters of Kealakekua Bay. Our expert guides will take you to the best snorkel site on The Big Island, and you'll have the opportunity to explore the vibrant coral reef and encounter a variety of marine life up close.

Our tour boat is equipped with all the necessary snorkeling gear, including masks, fins, and snorkels. We also provide flotation devices for those who need them. Our experienced guides will provide you with safety instructions and snorkeling tips before you dive in, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience for all.

Our RHIB boat, Manta Raiv, provides an intimate experience for a maximum of 14 passengers. Manta Raiv cuts through Kona's waters with ease, allowing us to quickly reach various snorkeling sites. When it's time to snorkel, you'll enter and exit the water with a swim ladder.

The boat ride from Honokohau Harbor to Kealakekua Bay takes about 30 minutes, depending on the snorkeling site we select based on the day's conditions. As we travel along the Kona Coast, your US Coast Guard certified captain and crew will educate you with historical facts about the surrounding areas. Upon reaching the snorkeling site, your swim guide will assist you into the water and guide you across the reef to the best snorkeling spots. We typically visit spend about one hour in the water at Kealakekua Bay. 

This 3-hour adventure comes with everything you need to snorkel, including a high-quality mask, snorkel, and fins. All you need is a bathing suit and you’ll be ready to go! Along with snorkel gear, you’ll be offered island-sourced pineapple, non-alcoholic refreshments, and snacks. We recommend you bring a towel, hat, sunglasses, and a waterproof camera. There’s room on the boat for your backpack, purse, and other reasonably sized items.

____
# Important:
We have a minimum age requirement of 5 years old, and all minors must be accompanied by an adult. We have a maximum weight requirement of 280 pounds.

____
# Safe and Humane Practices:
We do not allow touching or harassing of wildlife. Your swim guide will educate you on our humane approach to engaging with marine life.

____
# Our Boat:
Our boat, Manta Raiv, carries up to 14 guests and has a bimini cover for shade. There is no restroom on Manta Raiv.

____
# Safety:
All captains are US Coast Guard certified. All captains and crew are trained in First Aid and CPR. Life vests for all passengers are on board.

____
# Sunscreen:
Please apply reef-safe sunscreen prior to your tour. Sunscreen is a huge threat to our delicate coral reefs, and it’s important to use environmentally safe sunscreen that’s applied at least 30 minutes before entering the water.

____
# Weather Condition:
If the seas are too rough, we will reschedule your tour. We would rather skip a tour than make you uncomfortable. Please make sure we have your cell phone # for the unlikely event of a cancellation due to weather conditions.
item.booking_notes:
##Tour Booking Confirmation

Your Kealakekua Bay (Captain Cook Monument) tour reservation is confirmed, and we’re excited to see you soon! In the meantime, please read the information below and call us at 808-987-1584 if we can help with anything.

_________________
##Meet Us At Honokohau Harbor

Please arrive 30 minutes before your tour’s departure time. We’ll meet you at the pavilion at Honokohau Harbor, near the restrooms on the north side of the harbor. When you turn off the highway towards the harbor, make your first right (there will be several large rocks on the corner), then follow the road past the fuel station on your left, and turn left after the fuel station. You will turn into a large parking lot, and you will see a pavilion (overhang with benches around the perimeter) next to the restrooms. Our crew will meet you at the pavilion, just before your time of departure, and will escort you to the vessel after checking you in.

The Honokohau Harbor is on Kealakehe Pkwy in Kailua-Kona, HI 96740. View the Google map for precise directions --> https://goo.gl/maps/rQtbFq4FB9CFUcmU7

Please note that our tours typically leave on time. If you are going to be late, please call us.
_________________
##This Tour Includes
- Tropical fruit
- Snacks
- Bottled water & nonalcoholic drinks 
- Snorkeling gear
- Professional snorkel guide

_____________________________
##Things To Bring

We recommend wearing your swimsuit to the harbor, and applying reef-safe sunscreen before you board the vessel. A towel, hat, and sunglasses are also recommended.

This tour includes snorkeling gear, and you are welcome to bring your own.

You may bring your own waterproof camera, or you can rent a GoPro from us. If you would like to rent a GoPro, please call us to reserve one for your tour.


_________________
##Snorkeling Gear
Our boat is fully equipped with quality snorkeling gear and fins for you. If you have your own gear, you're welcome to bring it. If you need a wetsuit, please call us to reserve one for your tour.
_________________
##Motion Sickness

If you get motion sickness, we recommend taking an over-the-counter medication such as non-drowsy Bo-nine. Many guests also find relief from using the wristbands that apply pressure to your wrists.

_________________
##Tipping 

Our staff appreciates tips from happy customers, and will gladly accept cash, venmo, paypal, and other popular payment methods.
_________________
##Weather Conditions

Kona’s ocean waters are typically calm, but we are sometimes forced to reschedule tours due to unsafe conditions. If high winds or surf are forecasted for the day of your tour, please have your phone available in case we need to contact you. Any cancellations due to weather will be issued a trip on another tour, or a full refund.
item.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.
